2/ Origins: Dogecoin 🐶✨

It all started in 2013 with Dogecoin — a light-hearted take on Bitcoin, featuring the Shiba Inu dog meme. What began as a joke quickly turned into a cult favorite with real-world use cases and a passionate community. 🚀

Thread on Meme Coins -:

1/ What are Meme Coins? 

Meme coins are cryptocurrencies inspired by internet jokes, trends, or cultural references. Think Dogecoin or Shiba Inu . But behind the memes, there’s a whole world of speculation, community power, and surprising market moves.
